This entire saga traumatized my younger sister and the divorce was rough. I’m completely disgusted with my ex brother in law and so is my entire inner family. We’ve completely cut contact with him. She said she hates him for cheating but accepts that she has kids with him so they are stuck together for life. But I have the right to not want someone I hate in my home and at my events. Am I wrong for not wanting him at events and parties I throw? I just don’t see it.

The Hard Truth** You’re **not an asshole** for wanting your home to be a **safe, drama-free zone**.
